text:
raj: FYI Acme Ops reported their month-end invoice is ~14k tokens higher than the dashboard total. They also got bumped to the next plan tier on the invoice even though dashboard shows below threshold. Can someone triage?

maria: Account and invoice id? Any screenshots of dashboard vs invoice?

raj: acct: ACME-9982, invoice: INV-2026-11-ACME. Screenshot link: https://redwood.s3/acro/snap_acme_11_30.png. Dashboard shows 1,186,432 tokens, invoice lists 1,200,521 tokens. Tier in dashboard = standard; invoice charged pro tier.

olivia: Thanks. Two quick things to check: 1) aggregation window/cutoff mismatch (UTC vs customer TZ), 2) duplicate ingestion/backfill after dashboard snapshot. I'll run a diff query on metering snapshots vs raw events.

olivia: Running quick SQL to compare counts by day and source id:

```
SELECT event_date, source, count(*) as events, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE account_id = 'ACME-9982' AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30'
GROUP BY event_date, source
ORDER BY event_date;
```

olivia: Also comparing snapshot table used by dashboard: metering.snapshots_monthly where snapshot_ts = '2026-11-30T23:59:00Z'.

deploy-bot: nightly-aggregation-job finished at 2026-12-01T00:05:12Z for tenant ACME-9982 (job-id: agg-20261201-00). Backfill detected 2,345 new events, delta tokens +14,089.

maria: That timestamp is after the dashboard snapshot cut (23:59). Invoice generation pulls aggregation at job completion (00:05) which explains extra tokens. But why did backfill run after snapshot for already-ingested events?

olivia: Checking logs: looks like a delayed embedding backfill for source=async-embed-worker retried failed deliveries between 23:50-23:59, and a separate backfill process dedup check failed because events had different request_ids (retries produced new ids). So they were double-counted by the invoice aggregation but not in the dashboard snapshot.

olivia: Relevant log snippet:

```
2026-12-01T00:03:58Z backfill-run tenant=ACME-9982 source=async-embed-worker processed=2345 new_tokens=14089 request_ids_dedup=false
2026-12-01T00:04:01Z ingestion-service accepted events count=2345 trace=tr-9a3
```

maria: Understood. So root cause = backfill completed after dashboard snapshot + dedup gap for retry request_ids. Two prongs: invoice reflects final aggregated state, dashboard captured earlier snapshot. We need to determine expected behavior and whether invoice should be adjusted.

raj: Customer is upset because they didn't expect post-cutoff charges. They want either a credit or explanation that explains why they were bumped to pro tier.

maria: For this specific invoice we can issue a one-time credit for the extra tokens and reclass the tier. I need an approval from finance ops. Can you create a credit memo request with the delta tokens and link to logs?

olivia: I'll open an infra ticket to add request_id deduping to the backfill path and to lock the backfill so it cannot run across the dashboard snapshot boundary. Proposed fixes: 1) honor canonical request_id for dedupe, 2) enforce backfill window to close before snapshot ts, 3) add alert when backfill delta > X% of snapshot.

maria: Thanks. For immediate customer response: offer a credit to bring billed tokens down to dashboard total and mention we're fixing the root cause. I'll draft the outbound message.

raj: Can you also include recommended steps for customers to avoid this (e.g., client retry idempotency)? They asked what to change on their side.

olivia: Yes — ask them to pass client-generated request_id (idempotency key) on retries and ensure our ingestion honors that header. I'll confirm once infra change is in.

maria: Filed credit request CR-2026-ACME-11 (assigned to finance-ops). Attached logs and diff CSV.

olivia: Filed infra bug INF-4521 to add dedupe + backfill window lock. ETA for patch: 3 business days. Will add monitor.

raj: I'll send the customer: sorry + credit offer + ETA for engineering fix. Ping me when finance approves. :thumbsup:

maria: :eyes: noted. Will update CR when approved.

olivia: Quick follow up action items:
- olivia: run full token diff and attach CSV (done, link: https://redwood.s3/acme/diff_2026_11.csv)
- olivia: infra ticket INF-4521 (added owners infra/ingest)
- maria: credit memo request CR-2026-ACME-11
- raj: customer comms

raj: Thanks team — I'll close the loop with Acme in the next hour.

maria: thanks, will flag if finance needs more details.

olivia: once INF-4521 is live I'll add a dashboard panel showing backfill deltas per tenant to catch future surprises. :mag:
